source: Bay Area free & discounted museum/zoo/aquarium/garden admission research (2026)
disclaimer: Policies change frequently and several are in flux for 2026. Always advise the user to verify on the venue's official site or by phone before relying on a specific discount. Programs require the physical benefits card plus matching photo ID.

programs.name: Museums for All
programs.benefit: Free to $5 admission for up to 4 people (varies by site).
programs.how: Present EBT/benefits card + photo ID at the door. No reservation needed at most sites. Available all operating hours, year-round.
programs.notes: 1,600+ participating museums nationwide. Terms vary by site (free vs $1 vs $3 vs $5). P-EBT and SUN Bucks are frequently excluded.

programs.name: SF Museums for All
programs.benefit: Up to 4 free or $3 tickets per visit at ~28 participating SF museums.
programs.how: Show benefits card + proof of SF residency. Permanent, year-round.
programs.notes: Nearly 1 in 4 San Franciscans qualify. SF-resident-only — separate from the national Museums for All.

programs.name: Discover & Go
eligibility: Participating Bay Area library card (SF, Oakland, Berkeley, Contra Costa, San Mateo, Marin/MARINet, Santa Clara County, San Jose, etc.)
programs.benefit: Free or deeply discounted passes reservable online.
programs.how: Reserve online with a participating library card. Minimum age 14-18 depending on library; two active reservations at a time; valid photo ID required.
programs.notes: High-demand venues (Cal Academy, Exploratorium, BADM, The Tech, Filoli) cap quickly — reserve up to ~2 months ahead.

programs.name: Bank of America Museums on Us
programs.scope: BoA / Merrill / BoA Private Bank cardholders
eligibility: Bank of America, Merrill, or BoA Private Bank credit or debit card
programs.benefit: One free general admission on the first full weekend of each month.
programs.how: Show card + photo ID (cardholder only). Excludes special exhibitions.
programs.notes: Confirmed 9-county participants: Legion of Honor, de Young, OMCA, San Jose Museum of Art (Sundays only), The Tech (select weekends), Computer History Museum, Sonoma Valley Museum of Art, Napa Valley Museum Yountville. SFMOMA is seasonal (Jun-Sep). Asian Art Museum is NOT on the official roster despite some local guides citing it.

programs.name: Blue Star Museums
eligibility: Active-duty military (Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, Coast Guard)
U.S. Public Health Service Commissioned Corps
programs.benefit: Free admission for the service member plus up to five family members.
programs.dates2026: May 16, 2026 (Armed Forces Day) through September 7, 2026 (Labor Day)
programs.how: Show CAC, DD Form 1173, or 1173-1. Family members may visit independently with a valid dependent ID even if the service member is deployed.
programs.notes: IMPORTANT: Does NOT cover veterans or retirees unless a venue independently offers veteran pricing. Dates are strictly May 16 - Sept 7, 2026.

programs.name: Reciprocal membership networks
eligibility: Paid membership at a participating home museum
programs.benefit: ASTC Passport (science centers, free 90+ miles from home museum), AZA (zoos/aquariums, ~50% off), ACM (children's museums, ~50% off), NARM and ROAM (free general admission at 1,000+ art/history museums).
programs.how: Benefits attach to a paid membership. If you visit a venue 2-3+ times/year, a membership often beats per-visit discounts.

venues.name: California Academy of Sciences
pathways: Museums for All: $5 Daytime or NightLife (EBT/CalFresh/WIC/Lifeline/Medi-Cal), up to 4
Military: $3 off Daytime year-round for active-duty; free on Veterans Day and during Fleet Week for veterans/retired/active
venues.freeDays: Free for ages 2 and under; free SF K-12 field trips. General free days currently on hold.
venues.notes: Does NOT participate in reciprocal admission programs.

venues.name: Exploratorium
pathways: Museums for All & SF Museums for All: $5 admission, up to 4 (Daytime or After Dark)
venues.freeDays: Mother's Day is the annual pay-what-you-wish day.
venues.notes: On-site purchase only for the $5 rate. Has a CBO community access program.

venues.name: de Young Museum
venues.type: art museum (Fine Arts Museums of SF)
pathways: Museums for All: free general admission (Medi-Cal/EBT/SNAP)
Veterans & active military: free general admission
Disability: free general admission + Access Days for visitor + companion
venues.freeDays: Free every Saturday for all 9-county Bay Area residents (permanent collection, ID required); Free First Tuesdays for everyone; ages 17 & under always free.
venues.notes: Shares programs with the Legion of Honor.

venues.name: Legion of Honor
venues.type: art museum (Fine Arts Museums of SF)
pathways: Museums for All: free general admission (Medi-Cal/EBT/SNAP)
Veterans & active military: free general admission
Disability: free general admission + Access Days
venues.freeDays: Free every Saturday for all 9-county Bay Area residents (ID required); Free First Tuesdays for everyone; ages 17 & under always free.
venues.notes: Shares programs with the de Young.

venues.name: SFMOMA

venues.freeDays: Ages 18 & under free daily. Free First Thursdays is TEMPORARILY PAUSED (paused indefinitely as of late Jan 2026 for lack of a sponsor). Periodic Free Family Days and Free Community Days continue.

Oakland Zoo left Museums for All (Feb 4, 2025) for its own Bay to Zoo program; possible 2026 reinstatement reported.
Blue Star covers active-duty/Guard/Reserve families ONLY — not veterans/retirees unless a venue independently offers veteran pricing. Dates strictly May 16 - Sept 7, 2026.
